camera: 同侧悬空中全景，抬手承接升空
key_prompt: Preserve airborne white-haired horned GPT, her pale gown, one tail and TWO spread membranous wings. Replace the glaring white windows with the established cathedral night: tall pointed blue stained-glass windows, warm amber candle clusters, carved pillars and dark vault. Match the warm-night lighting of previous rising shot. No daylight and no plain new hall. Hover only a short distance above the floor.
motion_prompt: GPT settles from her upward rise into a controlled low hover, lifts one hand slowly to begin her invocation and keeps her gaze focused ahead. Her two wings make one restrained correction then hold; hair and gown trail down with gravity. Small upward camera follow only, no orbit or continued climb. Blue night windows and amber lamps stay unchanged.

camera: 教主短促释放，保持与千问反打轴线
key_prompt: Preserve red-haired black-gold priest in the same dark blue and amber cathedral. One arm extended toward screen left, restrained amber magic at the fingertips, not yet a beam. Clean matte inked face and large hard-edged robe folds. No full-screen fire.
motion_prompt: The priest thrusts his hand once and releases one narrow amber bolt toward screen left. One clear anticipation and release, his sleeve follows through and settles. Fixed low medium shot, no camera orbit, no second shot or repeated casting.

camera: 扇轴极近景，实体单叶脱离
key_prompt: Preserve the ornate blue-violet fan close-up. One adult RIGHT hand holds the fan pivot; visible physical ribs and blue-gold leaf panels. Thin blue-violet magic traces just ONE outermost physical fan leaf. Retain the whole fan silhouette and pivot. No floating duplicate fan, no giant magic circle, no extra fingers. Painted cathedral background.
motion_prompt: Thin blue-violet light runs along the gold lines of the outermost leaf. That ONE physical rigid leaf unlocks at the pivot and launches off screen right. The rest of the fan remains held firmly by the right hand with a visible missing outer leaf. The launched object is solid patterned material with a narrow magic edge, not multiple light blades. Fixed close shot, fast release and immediate cut.

camera: 短距离伴飞至截击，撞击后失速
key_prompt: Preserve the single long blue-gold patterned fan leaf in midair, moving screen right. Put one small incoming amber projectile ahead to its right with clear air between. Thin blue-violet magic film hugs the physical leaf. Dark blue cathedral arches and amber lamps, flat drawn effects. No other projectiles or fan copies.
motion_prompt: The one physical fan leaf flies screen right and meets the single amber projectile. At contact its thin blue-violet film brightens, fractures into a few drawn fragments and disappears; the amber projectile breaks apart. The solid leaf remains whole, slows and starts falling only AFTER contact. Brief lateral camera follow then stop on collision. One impact, no prolonged free flight.

camera: 抬手近景保持，将余量留给吟唱表演
key_prompt: Keep the existing close view of GPT face and raised hand, with TWO horns and matte pale clothing. Replace bright white windows with the same dark blue stained-glass and warm amber rim light established in 069/070. Preserve pointed tracery and carved stone. No daytime or empty simplified new cathedral. Draw only a few small water beads around her hand.
motion_prompt: GPT speaks one short focused invocation, her raised fingers softly gather inward as several small drawn water beads lift past them. Her eyes rise toward the unseen ceiling. Hair moves gently upward in the gathering force, but her head and shoulders remain steady. Fixed close view, no repeated arm lift or extra hands, no camera zoom.

camera: 罩内保护中景，单次承托
key_prompt: Preserve Kimi at left supporting orange-haired Claude at right INSIDE an opaque indigo protective dome. Claude remains chained by BOTH wrists to the high wooden cross; ankles still restrained, feet supported on its wooden footrest. Charred torn white-orange dress and veil remain unchanged. Her orange flower is on HER LEFT with black ribbon. Kimi blades are sheathed, not pointed at Claude. Simple drawn indigo dome curves behind them, no stars or teleport portal. Replace the ENTIRE visible background with an opaque dark-indigo curved membrane. No candles, windows, buildings or architecture anywhere. Remove ALL visible long swords and knives; two C-shaped crescent blades are sheathed BEHIND Kimi waist and completely hidden from this angle. Keep only two people with their original headbands.
motion_prompt: Kimi puts a steady supporting arm behind Claude upper back. Claude leans a little into the support while both chained wrists remain fixed to the cross. Kimi glances toward the outside threat; Claude breathes unevenly but does not stand free or recover. Fixed medium shot, subtle weight transfer only, retain restraints, costume damage and high platform floor.

camera: 外景水滴近景向上带视线
key_prompt: Keep one large water droplet rising in front of the moonlit gothic cathedral spires. Redraw water as clean outlined translucent blue shapes with two or three white highlight strokes, not a glass marble or photographic refraction. Painted night clouds and amber windows, no bokeh. Small droplets trail beneath the main droplet.
motion_prompt: The main water droplet rises upward, elongates briefly from acceleration and leaves the top of frame; the smaller droplets follow after it. The camera tilts gently up to carry the eye toward the sky. Draw the movement with simple cel-shaped highlights and a few speed lines, no photoreal fluid or endless wobble loop.

camera: 教堂仰景，云涡聚拢后切出
key_prompt: Preserve low view of gothic cathedral spires beneath a large rotating night cloud vortex. Use painted layered gouache clouds with broad dark blue shapes and thin drawn moonlit edges. Keep cathedral buildings intact and warm windows small; no realistic volumetric simulation, no bright day sky, no new towers.
motion_prompt: The layered night clouds spiral inward once with increasing urgency, drawing scattered blue water streaks into the center. The vortex mouth becomes defined, then a concentrated blue glow forms deep inside. Camera holds the spires as a stable scale reference, tiny upward tilt only. End at the gathering peak before the dragon emerges. No prolonged repetitive rotation.

camera: 外部俯斜角追随下冲，落点固定中殿
key_prompt: Preserve the huge BLUE WATER dragon descending toward the cathedral central nave roof from the night clouds. This is a summoned water construct, not GPT transformed into a white dragon. Clear readable dragon head and neck with drawn blue mass, white foam contours and a single continuous body. Gothic roof and surrounding towers stay intact except the intended central nave strike point. Two-tone painted blue water, no realistic fluid.
motion_prompt: The blue water dragon dives decisively down and forward toward ONE point in the central nave roof. Its head leads, neck and water body follow with a strong S curve. The camera follows the downward head motion briefly while keeping the roof target clear. Contact begins with a compact burst of drawn tile fragments at the central nave ONLY. Do not destroy the rear altar vault, side windows or towers. Cut on impact, not after a long looping dive.

camera: 内仰景，延续外景下冲方向
key_prompt: Keep the same drawn water dragon entering through the large jagged opening at upper LEFT and the close stone debris at left. REPAIR the entire separate round sky/moon hole at UPPER RIGHT with continuous intact dark stone vaulted ceiling. Only ONE roof opening remains, at upper left where dragon body crosses the broken edge. No sky or moon visible at upper right. Keep blue side windows intact. Clear 2D outlines and flat water highlight shapes.
motion_prompt: The existing blue water dragon continues downward from the single opening at upper left. Its head and neck sweep into the central nave, a few loose stones fall behind. Camera tilts down slightly following its head. The repaired upper right ceiling remains solid and intact; no new impact or opening, no entire cathedral collapse.

camera: 教主反应近景，以有因蓝光换色
key_prompt: Preserve the red-haired priest close view and black-gold collar. Initial warm amber rim light is crossed by a cool blue light coming from above-left, motivated by the water dragon. Same night cathedral. Matte inked face, broad hair locks, flat shadow shapes.
motion_prompt: The priest raises his eyes sharply toward the descending blue water dragon. Cool blue light sweeps across his face once, his brows tense and jaw sets. He begins lifting his forearm defensively at the end. Fixed close shot, one concise reaction, no repeated head turns or exaggerated open-mouth loop.

camera: GPT发令中景，龙头和指向同框
key_prompt: Preserve GPT in pale dress, two horns, two spread wings and one tail hovering in the dark cathedral. A BLUE WATER dragon curves behind her, its distinct head visible to her side, not covering her face or directing out of her body. Keep the central ceiling hole and otherwise intact blue windows/amber lamps. Draw the dragon as graphic cel water with a clear silhouette.
motion_prompt: GPT gives one decisive forward pointing command. The water dragon turns its head in the same direction, coils its neck once for anticipation, then surges away along her pointing line toward the priest off screen. Hair and gown recoil from the passing water force. Camera holds GPT and dragon head together until launch, no orbit, no dragon duplication and no white-dragon transformation yet.

camera: 撞盾中全景，冲击后交代防御结果
key_prompt: Preserve the red-haired priest behind a compact amber defensive shield in the cathedral nave, facing an incoming blue water dragon. Dragon attack comes from screen left, shield/priest at screen right. Use clean drawn water shapes, flat amber shield and broad stone shadows. Keep high altar separate and higher in the background. No photoreal splash cloud.
motion_prompt: The blue water dragon hits the amber shield once. The shield visibly bows inward under the impact, cracks with thin amber lines, then the water force bursts around its edges and rushes down the nave. Reveal the priest bracing behind the damaged defense after the impact peak rather than covering the screen with foam throughout. Fixed low wide shot with brief impact shake, rapid falloff of debris, no repeated attacks.

camera: 低位抓阶，水退露出受力
key_prompt: Preserve the black-robed acolyte lying low on the stone stairs, both hands gripping a solid step edge against water flowing down toward the nave. Keep fingers and the step contact readable, robe weighted against the body. Blue drawn shallow water, dark night cathedral. No collapsed rear vault or new wreckage. Hooded acolyte is a dark-haired MAN, face shadowed under black hood, NO orange hair, flower, veil or Claude. ALL candles and braziers are extinguished, cool moonlight only.
motion_prompt: The acolyte clings to the step with both hands as one pulse of water pulls his robe downstream. His elbows bend to resist and his knees scrape the next step. The pulse subsides and water drains down the stairs, leaving him still exhausted and gripping the edge. Fixed low camera, short action and settle, no repeated identical flood pulses and no floating body.

camera: 最高祭坛空间定场，浅水沿阶溢下
key_prompt: Preserve wide view of the OPAQUE INDIGO dome enclosing the entire cross and both Claude and Kimi on the HIGHEST ALTAR platform. The dome base sits on dry stone at top of the stairs; shallow blue water is outside and runs DOWN the stairs toward the nave. Keep rear central window broken by Kimi only, side stained windows and rear vault intact. Black charred timber outside the dome is extinguished, no purple flames remain. Draw reflections as simple blue strokes, not mirrors. No acolyte closeup, no person standing on top of dome. ALL candles and braziers are extinguished, no warm lamps. The source dome and platform composition is mandatory.
motion_prompt: Shallow water outside the indigo dome flows off the high platform and down the stairs. The dome remains firmly anchored, with faint smooth protective lines moving once across its surface. The camera slowly pulls back just enough to show the high platform, stair edge and lower flooded nave in one readable hierarchy. No moving cross, no new opening, no fire reigniting and no transparent dome exposing dry characters to rain.

camera: 低位落地接柱后同伴，翼收拢
key_prompt: Preserve GPT descending near the cathedral aisle with Qianwen and the child sheltered behind a side pillar. GPT has two membranous wings, two horns and ONE tail. Repair excessive background destruction: ONLY a jagged central nave roof hole is open; rear altar vault, side columns and most blue windows remain intact. Wet floor with simplified painted reflections, no new ruins. Qianwen holds the child on her LEFT arm and closed fan in RIGHT hand. Qianwen is the original PURPLE/BLUE-haired braided woman, not Claude; blue whale child hat preserved. Priest remains red-haired MAN, NO orange flower/veil. ALL candles and lamps extinguished, cool moonlight only. Keep indigo dome visible on highest altar in background, enclosing cross, not priest on a throne.
motion_prompt: GPT lowers gently, one foot touches the wet stone, then the other settles and both knees absorb the landing. Her two wings fold close behind her after landing, gown and hair follow through and stop. Qianwen stays behind the side pillar supporting the child. Small downward camera follow matching the landing, then hold. No second landing, no water dragon still wrapping around her and no collapse of surrounding walls.
